This bag extends the Keeper's inventory by 9 slots but can only hold certains items related to farming.
The {{Item|Recipe farmers bag}} can be bought from [[Tanner]] after having progressed enough through the [[Game of Crone]] DLC [[refugee camp]] questline. She also sells the bag.
